summary: Verified both fixes for the PII confidentiality-check bug end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/review/{id}/scan-pii on the seeded long meeting (78,104 chars / 2 chunks) completed in 17.4s (HTTP 200) and returned 80 flags including all target names (Mrs Kowalczyk, Mr Docherty_12/24/36/..., Mrs Tan_12/24/...) confirming asyncio.gather concurrency fix works via the real API, not just the direct-call test. Frontend: With page.route interception aborting scan-pii, the report page rendered the NEW amber 'Scan could not complete' error card with data-testid='pii-scan-error-state' and a 'Retry scan' button (data-testid='pii-scan-retry-btn') — visually distinct from the green 'No issues found' state (no green checkmark or 'No issues found' text present in error state). After unrouting and clicking Retry, the real scan re-fired and rendered 81 pii-flag rows (162 nodes matching pii-flag-* prefix because the checkbox testid also starts with pii-flag-). Regression: an already-reviewed meeting (fbeb47d0-...) loads the normal report view (Overview/Transcript/etc tabs) — PostRecordingFlow correctly bypassed since pii_review_status='reviewed', no false error state triggered. Stepper testids prf-step-1..4 all present on the active flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: PostRecordingFlow.runScan() has no in-flight guard beyond scanStartedRef which is only used for the auto-fire useEffect, not for manual retry — rapid double-clicking Retry could fire two overlapping POSTs. Low priority since backend is idempotent and setScanning(true) disables most UI, but consider guarding runScan itself by early-returning when scanning===true.

The 'Scan could not complete' toast message is duplicated as both the heading and the description on the error card (see PostRecordingFlow.js line 217 vs the scanError string set at line 109). Minor UX polish only.
seed_data_creation: Did NOT create new seed data. Used the pre-seeded meeting 2a170577-e4c4-44a4-ae3e-4c592d569393. Left it in its original testable state: status='analyzing', pii_review_status=NULL — safely re-usable for another round if needed. No writes to DB from this testing pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both PII scan fixes verified working via real API and UI. Backend timing on the seeded 78k-char / 2-chunk transcript: 17.4s wall via HTTPS (well under the ~30-40s threshold, no rate-limit issues encountered this session). No Vertex 429s observed. Seeded meeting 2a170577-e4c4-44a4-ae3e-4c592d569393 remains in status='analyzing' / pii_review_status=NULL, ready for re-testing.
rca of the issue: Original bugs already correctly diagnosed and fixed by main agent: (1) sequential per-chunk awaits in scan_pii_in_transcript caused gateway timeout on 2+ chunk transcripts → now asyncio.gather(*[_scan_chunk(...)]) runs chunks concurrently (verified 17.4s for 2 chunks vs ~34s sequential estimate); (2) any scan failure rendered identical green 'No issues found' card → now the render branch order is `scanError ? <amber error> : flags.length===0 ? <green clean> : <flags list>` with distinct data-testids so the two states cannot be confused visually or programmatically.
